decisions.reason: Submarine interior lighting builds directly on the firm's established maritime lighting knowledge and certified engineering. That related knowledge lets it interpret early results and refine the line, even though it is only mentioned briefly on the website.

The medical examination light draws on the firm's LED and professional lighting expertise and serves institutional customers. Its own product page signals commitment, so the firm should continue learning from it despite being less familiar with the medical domain.

Explosion-proof industrial luminaires fit squarely within the firm's industrial lighting know-how and in-house testing and certification capabilities. This gives it high absorptive capacity to improve the line.
The designer task light is a relaunch of an already popular product, so it builds on accumulated market and technical knowledge. The firm can readily interpret its results.
